Step 2: Complete the FREA97H3 placement survey at UTSC Department of Language Studies - FREA97H3 (Beginner French II) Placement Survey – Fill out form and follow the instructions you receive after submitting.
Check your status through ACORN to see whether you have been approved. (APP = approval; REF = refused; INT = no decision yet)
PLEASE NOTE: You may enroll in FREA97H3 if you have successfully completed FREA96H3 or its equivalent, or if you have completed any French courses up to Grade 9 French.
If you have completed Grade 10 French or any level above Grade 10, you may not enroll in FREA97H3. You must complete the French Language Placement Test found at https://www.utsc.utoronto.ca/dls/french-placement-test.
Your proficiency will be monitored by the course instructor throughout the term. If the course instructor feels that your proficiency level is not appropriate for the level of the class (whether too high or too low), they will have you removed from the class.

notes:
Timetable Instructions
The course is taught in English.
Delivery Instructions
Why did Walmart’s attempt to break into the German market go down in flames? What factors have turned soccer clubs like Bayern Munich and Borussia Dortmund into global brands? How has globalization impacted traditional German culture and what is unique about the German and European experience of globalization?
The course explores the contemporary character of globalization patterns and problems in German contexts and prepares students for future academic and professional opportunities in Germany and beyond. The course is highly recommended as preparation for students interested in participating in iPRAKTIKUM, the Department of German’s internationalization and experiential Learning program, which provides exciting placements in Germany and the GTA. It also fulfills a requirement for the U of T’s Global Scholar Certificate.

Tutorial Enrolment Instructions:
